items.title: Comparison of Clonidine and Tramadol as Adjuvants to Local Anaesthetics in Supraclavicular Brachial Plexus Block
items.field: Anaesthesia, OT Technology, Allied Health & Healthcare Researchers
items.description: This paper is a comparative clinical study in regional anaesthesia, examining whether clonidine or tramadol provides better block characteristics when added to a local anaesthetic for supraclavicular brachial plexus block.
